steps.note: The yeast turns the lactose, at 50-108 g/l in the study, into alcohol without added enzymes.

steps.name: distil
steps.note: The spirit comes off the still at 48 % alcohol.
It is filtered three times, once through coconut-husk carbon.
It is brought down to 40 % alcohol for bottling.

processing.text: The fermentation figures come from a study on whey permeate; Black Cow names only a yeast that works on lactose, not which one.

links.name: Optimizing ethanol from cheese whey permeate by Kluyveromyces marxianus UFV-3

sources.text: The distilling, filtering and strengths are from the Black Cow article, and the fermentation temperature, pH and lactose range from the study abstract.
